source.source_family: Revised Local Development Order / North East Low Carbon Enterprise Zone / adopted Local Plan policy AS2.5
source.identifier_namespace: North Tyneside Local Plan policy AS2.5 River Tyne North Bank
source.data_date_basis: North Tyneside Council formally adopted the Local Plan on 20 July 2017; the revised LDO separately allows relevant condition-detail submissions by 19 November 2032.
source.license: North Tyneside Council public planning documents and public ArcGIS Enterprise Zone service; the GIS service states copyright to the Planning Policy Team / Planning Department / Capita North Tyneside; no layer-specific reuse licence is stated in the public service metadata.
source.source_geometry_availability: North Tyneside's public Enterprise_Zones FeatureServer exposes layer 1 as an esriGeometryPolygon dataset of three Enterprise Zone areas in EPSG:27700; the service description includes the Former Swan Hunter shipyard. Exact single-feature extraction and canonical parcel spatial join are delegated to local OpenCode.

field_evidence.designation: part of the North East Low Carbon Enterprise Zone
ldo_permitted_use_classes: B2 general industry subject to exclusions and conditions

source.source_file_sha256_reason: The official council PDFs and public GIS service were accessed through public web transport; raw PDF/GIS response bytes were not acquired into the controlled batch workspace, so no source-file SHA-256 is fabricated.

canonical_join: not performed; local OpenCode exact-feature extraction, spatial join and materialization required
